final.answer: GV-12-3 is described as a Type 165 2/2-way solenoid valve, so yes, it needs electrical power to operate. The datasheet lists supply voltages of 24V DC, 230V 50/60Hz and 115V 50/60Hz, so 24 V DC will work and you do not need 230 V AC. Variants are available with EPDM or FKM gaskets for each of the 24V DC, 110V AC and 230V AC coil voltages; use the voltage and current type given on the valve's type plate, with a tolerance of ±10%. Power consumption is low: on AC, 20 VA at inrush and 11 VA in operation (5 W on DC); the electrical connection is a cable plug (appliance plug, IP65).
